name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
tagline: Flexible-hose maker whose AI data-center liquid-cooling pivot is now confirmed in the numbers (Q1 FY27 revenue +72%, skids 23% of mix) and is a core-trusted investor's primary holding - but ~107x P/E leaves no margin of safety
business_overview: Aeroflex manufactures corrugated stainless steel flexible hoses (temperature range -270C to 700C) for industrial piping applications, and has recently pivoted aggressively into liquid cooling skids/flow-control components and assemblies for AI data centers, supplying to Vertiv (a key hyperscaler infrastructure vendor). Management is scaling skid assembly capacity from 2,000 units toward 15,000 units through FY27, targeting revenue of Rs 1,000+ Cr by FY29 at 23-25% EBITDA margins. Debt-free balance sheet; Ashish Kacholia has been increasing his stake via preferential issue.
fundamentals_table: ~14-16% ROE / ~18.9% ROCE (FY26; the earlier 1.09% ROCE figure was a stale/bad data pull, not real)
Rs 442 Cr (+17.5%) / Rs 99.7 Cr (22.6% margin, +156 bps) / Rs 55.5 Cr (+6%, held back by higher depreciation)
Revenue Rs 146 Cr (+72% YoY), EBITDA Rs 33.5 Cr (23.0% margin), PAT Rs 18.8 Cr (+162%); skids = 23% of revenue
Near debt-free (Rs 9 Cr borrowings, Rs 421 Cr reserves)
fundamentals_narrative: The deep read corrects the record: the 'ROCE 1.09%' figure in the prior write-up was a bad data pull, not a real profitability collapse - screener shows FY26 ROCE ~18.9% and 3-yr ROE ~16%, and the business is genuinely accelerating. FY26 revenue Rs 442 Cr (+17.5%), EBITDA Rs 99.7 Cr at a 22.6% margin (up 156 bps); Q1 FY27 then stepped up hard to Rs 146 Cr revenue (+72% YoY) with a 23.0% EBITDA margin and PAT +162%. The liquid-cooling skid business is now ~23% of revenue and scaling (capacity 6,000 -> 9,000 done, 15,000 targeted by Oct-Nov 2026, slipped from the earlier June-2026 date), funded by a Rs 55 Cr preferential issue (Feb 2026, Rs 182.70/sh, Ashish Kacholia allotted ~4.1 lakh shares) plus internal accruals - balance sheet stays near debt-free. The unresolved problem is valuation: at ~Rs 7,174 Cr market cap and ~107x trailing earnings the stock has round-tripped from its Rs 158 low back to new highs, so it is again priced for multi-year flawless execution.
technical_read: Stock has fully recovered from its Rs 158 low and is trading at/near all-time highs (~Rs 542 on 29-Aug-2026, +218% in a year). The earlier drawdown to Rs 158 has reversed on the confirmed skid ramp; the risk now is a high-multiple name giving back gains on any execution slip, not a broken chart.
sentiment_summary: Read the full 57-post thread (single batch, no escalation needed - thread fits under 50-post cap plus a handful more) spanning April 2025 to August 2026. Sentiment arc: early bullishness on the liquid-cooling pivot and Kacholia stake increase (Dec 2025-May 2026), a valuation-caution note at the peak of the re-rating (April-June 2026), then a detailed community TAM-sizing debate (July-Aug 2026) that converged on a more conservative, still-large opportunity after two posters (Neophyte, sumit680) worked through and corrected each other's skid/MW math live in the thread - a healthy sign of rigorous, self-correcting community analysis rather than one-way hype.

bull_case: phreakv6 (trusted, core-tier, extensively researched across Sai/Aeroflex/MTAR/TD Power as his top-4 portfolio) names this his single primary holding - the strongest individual conviction signal across this entire 15-stock batch
Q1 FY27 confirmed the inflection: revenue +72% YoY, EBITDA margin 23.0%, PAT +162%, skids already 23% of revenue - the ramp is showing up in the numbers, not just the narrative
Genuine pivot into AI data-center liquid cooling designed with Vertiv (management claims exclusive India partner for these skids); first commercial dispatches done in FY26
Profitability is fine, not broken - FY26 ROCE ~18.9%, margins expanding 156 bps to 22.6%; the prior '1.09% ROCE' was a data error
Debt-free, self-funding expansion (Rs 55 Cr preferential issue Feb 2026 + internal accruals); flexible-hose base business itself grew 41% YoY in Q1 FY27 with Rs 650-675 Cr peak-revenue potential

bear_case: Valuation is the core risk: ~107x trailing P/E at ~Rs 7,174 Cr market cap - the stock has round-tripped from Rs 158 back to new highs and is again priced for years of flawless execution
15,000-unit skid capacity slipped from June 2026 to Oct-Nov 2026 (external machine-supplier dependency) - a concrete, if modest, execution slip already on the record

FY26 PAT grew only 6% despite 26% EBITDA growth (depreciation/tax drag), and FCF was negative in FY25 (-Rs 78 Cr) and FY26 (-Rs 5 Cr) on the capex/working-capital build - cash conversion still has to prove out
Skid economics are gated by Vertiv's own data-center share and by hyperscaler capex staying strong; a single large downstream customer concentrates the opportunity

At ~Rs 7,000 Cr market cap a literal 10x in 2-3 years would need ~Rs 70,000 Cr - even management's Rs 1,000 Cr FY29 revenue / 25% margin target does not mathematically support that multiple; the re-rating has largely happened
GST demand order of Rs 7.19 Cr received (contested; immaterial to thesis but noted)
verdict_headline: Real, accelerating AI-cooling ramp confirmed by Q1 FY27 - and a core-trusted investor's primary holding - but ~107x P/E caps the upside
verdict_reasoning: The deep read is net-positive on the business: Q1 FY27 (+72% revenue, 23% EBITDA margin, +162% PAT, skids 23% of mix) confirms the inflection the prior write-up called unproven, and FY26 ROCE ~18.9% shows the '1.09%' figure was simply wrong
phreakv6 (core-tier trusted) holding this as his single primary position, plus a debt-free, self-funded, Vertiv-designed skid ramp, is a genuine and differentiated signal

But valuation has re-rated all the way back: ~107x trailing earnings at ~Rs 7,174 Cr market cap means the known growth is largely in the price; the capacity slip to Oct-Nov 2026 and still-negative FCF are reminders the execution bar is high

Conviction moves High -> Medium-High: business momentum and the trusted-holder signal are strong, but the multiple leaves little margin of safety and makes a literal 2-3yr 10x mathematically unlikely from here
